assertions.name: dark-tokens-no-pure-black
assertions.description: Dark surface uses dark navy/gray, not #000000

assertions.name: has-use-theme-hook
assertions.description: Exports useTheme hook for consuming components

assertions.name: uses-system-default
assertions.description: Initial theme respects system color scheme from useColorScheme()

prompt: Add dark mode to an Expo app. ThemeProvider context, dark color tokens (no pure black), toggle button with Reanimated transition. Initial theme from system preference.
